title: Personal Loans Care Desk Guidance: Moving the Monthly Due Day
content:
## Rule the desk applies

A borrower may move the monthly due day of an active Personal Loans loan. The due day can only be changed on a loan in active status. The loan has an amount past due of 0.00 and no hardship plan on the loan is in requested, offered or active status. At least the grade's minimum number of scheduled installments have been paid since funding, fewer than the grade's due-date changes per 12 months were recorded in the last 12 months, and fewer than the grade's due-date changes per loan were recorded over the life of the loan. The change is requested no later than the due-date request lead days before the current next due date. The latest permitted request date is found by counting the lead days back in calendar days from the current next due date, and a request on that date is in time.

The new due day must be a day from 1 to 28 and differ from the current one. The first due date under the new day is the first date falling on the new day that is later than the current next due date, so a change never makes a payment due sooner; that first due date may be at most the grade's maximum shift in calendar days after the current next due date, otherwise the change is not available. The maturity date moves the same way (the first date on the new day later than the old maturity date). The installment amount does not change; interest keeps accruing daily, so the extra days add interest that is collected through the normal allocation and any difference is absorbed by the final installment. No fee is charged for a due-date change. If AutoPay is active, the debit date follows the new due day automatically.

How the counts are read: installments paid since funding count every installment due date paid in full, net of returned payments, whatever its timeliness; the 12-month count takes changes recorded today or in the 364 days before; the lifetime count takes every change recorded on the loan.

## Lead time (5-day lead, hypothetical dates)

| Current next due date | Latest request date | Request on 14 May | Request on 16 May |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 May | 15 May | in time | too late |

## First new due date (20-day maximum shift, hypothetical dates)

| Current next due date | New due day | First date on the new day after it | Days later | Available |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 May | 25 | 25 May | 15 | yes |
| 10 May | 28 | 28 May | 18 | yes |
| 10 May | 5 | 5 June | 26 | no |
| 10 May | 10 | - | - | no: same day as now |
